message.reliable_advancements.no_server_: Server does not support advancement editing. Changes are visual only.
config.reliable_advancements.title: Better Advancements Configuration
config.reliable_advancements.doFade.tool: Darkens the background behind advancements when hovering over an entry.
config.reliable_advancements.criteriaDet: How to show criteria requirements on hover. Default: Shows obtained. Spoiler: Shows unobtained. All: Shows both.
config.reliable_advancements.requiresShi: Require holding Shift to see criteria details.
config.reliable_advancements.addToInvent: Add a button to open advancements from the player inventory.
config.reliable_advancements.showDebugCo: Shows internal GUI coordinates, useful for modpack makers aligning advancements.
config.reliable_advancements.orderTabsAl: Sorts the top advancement tabs alphabetically.
config.reliable_advancements.tabSortOrde: Root advancement IDs (e.g. minecraft:story/root) listed in the order their tabs should appear. Any tab not listed here comes afterwards.
config.reliable_advancements.unclampedSc: Lets you pan the advancement tab freely instead of stopping at the edges of the tree.
config.reliable_advancements.uiScaling.t: Scales the entire Better Advancements UI. Values below 50% might give odd results.
config.reliable_advancements.onlyUseAbov: Restricts tabs to only the top edge instead of wrapping around the screen.
config.reliable_advancements.inventoryBu: Whether the advancements shortcut in the inventory should be a Tab or a Button.
Adjust the horizontal position of the inventory button.
Adjust the vertical position of the inventory button.
config.reliable_advancements.customInven: Texture ID of a custom button background. Leave blank for vanilla.
Texture ID for the button background when hovered. Leave blank to reuse the standard texture.
The item ID to use for the advancements button in the inventory (e.g., minecraft:book or minecraft:emerald).
config.reliable_advancements.visibilityD: How many advancements ahead of unlocked ones are visible (vanilla default is 2, 1 reveals only direct children, -1 is unlimited).
config.reliable_advancements.requireRewa: Advancements have to be claimed after being unlocked to get the reward.
config.reliable_advancements.enableEditM: Right click advancements to edit their properties and rearrange them (Requires OP to sync).
config.reliable_advancements.showTooltip: If enabled, hovering over advancements while in edit mode will still display their title, description, and requirements.
config.reliable_advancements.showEditMod: Displays a button in the top right corner of the advancements screen to easily toggle Edit Mode on and off (Requires OP).
config.reliable_advancements.storeAdvanc: Saves in-game advancement edits to the mod's config folder (config/reliable_advancements_edits/) instead of the world save. On dedicated servers this setting is ignored and edits always go to the world save.
Saves in-game advancement edits to a world datapack instead of a config folder. Only relevant on dedicated servers, or when Store Edits Globally is off.
Draws directional arrows on advancement lines.
config.reliable_advancements.drawDirectL: Draws direct straight/angled lines between advancements instead of lines that bend around corners.
config.reliable_advancements.hideLines.t: Hides all connection lines between advancements.
config.reliable_advancements.defaultComp: Color of the connection line when an advancement is completed.
config.reliable_advancements.defaultUnco: Color of the connection line when an advancement is locked/uncompleted.
config.reliable_advancements.defaultComp: Color of the outer icon frame when an advancement is completed.
config.reliable_advancements.defaultUnco: Color of the outer icon frame when an advancement is locked.
config.reliable_advancements.defaultComp: Color of the title banner when an advancement is completed.
config.reliable_advancements.defaultUnco: Color of the title banner when an advancement is locked.
config.reliable_advancements.enableButto: Whether or not the inventory button should display a tooltip when hovered.
config.reliable_advancements.blurBackgro: Renders a persistent semi-transparent dark overlay over the background texture, making advancement connections and icons pop more.
Adjusts how dark the background overlay is when the darken setting is active.
It becomes unobtainable. Reset to vanilla to bring it back.
gui.reliable_advancements.dialog.delete_: They become unobtainable. Reset to vanilla to bring them back.
gui.reliable_advancements.dialog.reset_a: All edits to it are lost.
All edits to them are lost.
gui.reliable_advancements.dialog.reset_t: All edits in it are lost and deleted advancements come back.
gui.reliable_advancements.dialog.delete_: Its %s advancements become unobtainable. You can restore it later.
gui.reliable_advancements.dialog.permane: It will be permanently deleted and cannot be restored.
They will be permanently deleted and cannot be restored.
The tab and its custom advancements will be permanently deleted and cannot be restored.
gui.reliable_advancements.restore_tab.co: Its advancements come back with edits and progress intact.
